method: Analyze original timestamp intervals, duplicates, discontinuities, duration, and count. Keep packet ordering distinct from presentation ordering when codec reordering exists. Any retiming is a named development operation with mapping metadata, not repair disguised as native capture.
fixture: A source containing one forty-eight-millisecond gap and a later short interval that restores the average frame rate.
oracle: The per-frame integrity gate reports the gap even when the final average falls within tolerance.
mutant: Approve cadence using only total frames divided by duration.
